correctness.rationale: The class of world 1 in the least equivalence relation containing the union is precisely its reachability component. For a fixed s-set containing 1, each partition respects its cut, the s-side restrictions must jointly connect, and the complement restrictions are arbitrary; independent marking then contributes p^s. This gives both the exact probability and the connected-count recurrence, also at n=1. For the tail, the displayed ratio of U_{s+1} to U_s is uniformly bounded below 1 for 2≤s<n/2: below n^{2/3} it is o(1), up to n/4 its limiting upper bound is 3p/4, and in the remaining range it is at most p+o(1). Above half-size one can also bound the actual tail directly by p^{n/2}, since the unmarked size probabilities sum to one. Thus for fixed positive K the first omitted bound U_{K+1} has the stated scale, and successive fixed-size terms have relative scale W(n)^r/n^{r-1}. The first-order replacement of the leading Bell ratio does not have the required two-term accuracy: at the saddle ρ=W(n), the coefficient ratio for exp(e^z−1) gives B_{n-1}/B_n=(ρ/n)(1+1/(2n)+o(1/n)). In the same-radius integrals the extra e^{iθ} factor gives the correction κ₃/(2κ₂²)−1/(2κ₂), with κ₂=n(1+ρ), κ₃=n(1+3ρ+ρ²), by Gaussian integration. The resulting relative O(1/n) change with nonzero leading constant exceeds the claimed relative remainder.
